div.div:
Sequence numbers: 1 = load the list, 2 = sort by name (Ascending / Descending),
3 = filter (All files / Only .cpp / Only .png). Every branch rebuilds the visible list as
filterByType(sortByName(files, direction), filter): the chosen order survives the filter.
